subject: MAP stall — intervention plan & stakeholder sprint
messages:
From: lauren_bishop@redwood.ai
To: Emma Liu <emma.liu@helixhealth.com>, Jordan Smith <j.smith@helixhealth.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.ai, irene_choi@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-06-27T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: MAP stall — intervention plan & stakeholder sprint

Hi Emma / Jordan —

Thanks for the call this morning. We heard loud and clear that the current MAP timeline is slipping because of two tied blockers: (1) procurement needs a clearer SOW for internal legal review, and (2) evaluation environment readiness is behind schedule (security team triage).

I attached an updated MAP (MAP_v3.xlsx) with a short, time-boxed remediation proposal below. The ask: can Helix commit to a focused 3-day stakeholder sprint next week to unblock procurement and demo readiness? Proposed sprint goals: 
- Day 1: Align SOW scope + sign-off owners (legal, procurement, product)
- Day 2: Security & infra checklist complete for evaluation environment (Redwood + Helix infra lead)
- Day 3: Light smoke demo + acceptance criteria confirmation

If Helix agrees to the sprint, Redwood will: supply a trimmed SOW draft for sign-off (SOW_draft_v2.pdf), provide a prioritized test plan, and stand up a temporary evaluation cluster for the smoke demo.

Next steps: please confirm whether you can do the sprint window Mon–Wed next week (2027-07-05 to 2027-07-07) or propose a 3-day window. If procurement needs a shorter artifact first, note below what they need and by when.

Thanks — hoping to avoid a formal escalation if we can get a short, concentrated unblock.

— Lauren Bishop
Account Lead, Redwood Inference
lauren_bishop@redwood.ai
Redwood Inference

Attachments (2): MAP_v3.xlsx (spreadsheet), SOW_draft_v2.pdf (pdf)

From: Emma Liu <emma.liu@helixhealth.com>
To: lauren_bishop@redwood.ai
Cc: Jordan Smith <j.smith@helixhealth.com>, Procurement Team <procurement@helixhealth.com>
Date: 2027-06-27T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MAP stall — intervention plan & stakeholder sprint

Lauren —

Appreciate the clarity. Short answer: procurement can do a sprint, but we need a one-page SOW summary (bullet list of deliverables + data residency statement) by Friday EOD so our legal lead can pre-read. Also security wants an inventory of data flows for the eval cluster (PII/no-PII) before they clear infra access.

We can commit to a 3-day sprint the week of 2027-07-05 if you deliver the one-pager + data-flow inventory by 2027-07-02 COB.

Emma
VP Product, Helix Health
emma.liu@helixhealth.com

From: lauren_bishop@redwood.ai
To: ben_carter@redwood.ai, irene_choi@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-06-27T12:45:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: MAP stall — intervention plan & stakeholder sprint

Team — forwarding Helix's reply. Procurement wants a one-page SOW summary by COB Friday (2027-07-02) and a data-flow inventory for the eval cluster. Can Ben take the SOW one-pager? Irene, can you own the data-flow inventory and coordinate with our infra/security SME (Marissa) to get the template and required fields?

I need a realistic, deliverable plan for Helix by EOD Friday so they can lock the sprint. If we miss that, we lose the 3-day window and I expect procurement to push the close date another 3–4 weeks. That's the escalation risk.

Please ACK and list any blockers now.

— L

Attachment: SOW_draft_v2.pdf (SOW we can trim)

From: ben_carter@redwood.ai
To: lauren_bishop@redwood.ai, irene_choi@redwood.ai
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-06-27T14:07:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: MAP stall — intervention plan & stakeholder sprint

ACK — I will produce the one-page SOW summary by EOD Thursday (2027-07-01) so we have time for internal review. I'll pull the top deliverables and the data residency line you flagged.

Risks: The SOW trimming is straightforward, but if Helix legal insists on contract-level language in the one-pager we may need legal review which could add 48 hours. I'll draft language that is deliberately operational (non-contractual) and include a callout that final contractual terms are in the SOW.

Also, quick ask for Marissa: can you prepare the eval cluster data-flow template and confirm whether the temporary cluster will be hosted in our US region (us-west) or Helix's VPC? That affects who runs the checklist.

— Ben

From: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
To: lauren_bishop@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai, irene_choi@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-06-27T16:42:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MAP stall — intervention plan & stakeholder sprint

Lauren / Ben / Irene —

I can deliver the data-flow inventory template this afternoon and propose we mark fields as: data type, PII? (Y/N), ingress path, egress path, retention policy, and access controls. I'll attach the template and a short guide to fill it. Regarding hosting: Redwood can stand up the temp cluster in us-west; if Helix prefers their VPC, procurement needs an onboarding checklist that usually takes 48–72 hours. That will push the sprint.

My recommendation: ask Helix to accept Redwood-hosted eval cluster for the sprint. That keeps the 3-day window feasible. I'll share the template in 2 hours.

— Marissa
Senior Infra PM, Redwood Inference

From: lauren_bishop@redwood.ai
To: Emma Liu <emma.liu@helixhealth.com>, Jordan Smith <j.smith@helixhealth.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai, irene_choi@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-06-28T08:15:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MAP stall — intervention plan & stakeholder sprint — escalation note + proposed sprint charter

Emma / Jordan —

Thank you — we have an internal plan to meet your asks: Ben will deliver the one-page SOW summary by 2027-07-01 EOD, and Marissa will circulate the data-flow inventory template today. To preserve the sprint window, Redwood will provision the evaluation cluster in us-west for the smoke demo; Helix will retain final decision on whether to move to your VPC after the sprint.

Attached is a short sprint charter (in the MAP_v3.xlsx under the 'Sprint' tab) with roles and the decision matrix. If Helix can confirm the sprint window Mon–Wed 2027-07-05 to 2027-07-07 and Helen in procurement confirms internal attendees, we will lock resources.

Escalation note: if we cannot commit to the sprint this week, Helix's procurement timeline suggests a likely close-date slip of 3–4 weeks (internal legal queue + re-scheduling executive availability). I want to avoid a formal credit/escalation request, so my ask is for a firm confirmation on the one-pager deadline (2027-07-02 COB) and sprint attendees by EOD 2027-07-01.

Next meeting: proposed 30-min sprint kickoff Fri 2027-07-02 10:00 PT (to confirm roles). Please confirm.

Thanks — Lauren

Attachments referenced: sprint_backlog.csv (backlog), MAP_v3.xlsx (MAP with sprint tab), SOW_draft_v2.pdf (SOW draft)

From: Jordan Smith <j.smith@helixhealth.com>
To: lauren_bishop@redwood.ai, Emma Liu <emma.liu@helixhealth.com>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@helixhealth.com>
Date: 2027-06-28T16:42:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MAP stall — intervention plan & stakeholder sprint — escalation note + proposed sprint charter

Lauren / Team —

Thanks for the quick turnaround. We agree to the sprint window Mon–Wed 2027-07-05 to 2027-07-07 provided: (1) the one-page SOW summary is in our hands by 2027-07-02 COB, and (2) we receive the data-flow inventory template today so our security lead can pre-populate. Procurement will confirm attendees by EOD 2027-07-01.

We prefer Redwood-hosted eval cluster for the sprint to remove VPC onboarding delays. Confirmed — we'll plan for that. Looking forward to the kickoff call Fri at 10:00 PT.

Jordan
Program Manager, Helix Health
j.smith@helixhealth.com
